meta.title: המשך תנועה · A home for combat veterans after their service
meta.description: A home for men and women who served in combat roles. Three Friday mornings a month: a workout for every fitness level, coffee and a guest talk. No commitment, no talking circle.

hero.eyebrow: For combat veterans, after their service
title: Service ends.
The team doesn't have to.
hero.body: המשך תנועה is a home for men and women who served in combat roles. We meet three Friday mornings a month to train, have coffee and hear a guest talk — and we're building a nationwide network of local community centers.

always.title: Here for good
always.lead: We're not a program with a start and an end. We're a place that stays.
body: Regular meetings, several times every month. Come for the first time now, or come back after a break.
However long it's been since your discharge.

direction.title: Community centers across Israel
body: We're building a nationwide network of local community centers.
Each one with structured activity, and room for combat veterans to meet, move, find direction and build a good life.
Today we meet at Holmes Place in Modi'in. That's where it starts.
